questions.prompt: Is there a defect in how this service guarantees that a retried indexing request is applied only once? If so, mark the line(s) where it is; otherwise answer that there is none.
A retry arrives with a requestId that was fully processed earlier, but with different fields in the body. What is returned?
choices: A new version from a fresh upsert with the new fields
The originally recorded version, and the new fields are ignored
The latest version of the document

questions.prompt: Two tenants send requests with the same requestId. How does the processed-request lookup treat them?
choices: As the same request, so the second tenant gets the first tenant's version
As separate requests, since lookups are by tenant and requestId together
As the same request, but only if docId matches

questions.prompt: A request with an empty tags list is processed. Which calls are made to the index?
choices: upsert and appendTags with an empty list
Neither, because empty tags are invalid
